name: Charles Radtke
summary: A 36-year-old welterweight (12-5; 5-2 UFC), unranked, who has won two straight by grappling: an R3 rear-naked choke of Daniel Frunza in November 2025 and a 30-26 x3 decision over Francisco Prado at UFC 327. Both UFC losses were knockouts against strikers (Carlos Prates, Mike Malott). Stephen Thompson picked him for his retirement fight.

how_they_fight.Striking: Low output (about 2.2 significant strikes a minute) but real power: R1 TKOs of Gilbert Urbina (two knockdowns) and Matthew Semelsberger (0:51). Prado stunned him with a left hook early in R1 (Cageside).
how_they_fight.Grappling: His main weapon in recent fights. Against Frunza he took him down, took the back, nearly finished in R1, then choked him out at the end of R3 (LowKick); our data has nearly 12 minutes of control. Against Prado he landed 4 of 5 takedowns, held him down for about four minutes in R1, took the back in R2 and opened a cut with elbows (Cageside).
how_they_fight.Defense: Takes damage against good strikers: Carlos Prates stopped him at 4:47 of R1 (2024) and Mike Malott 26 seconds into R2 (2025). Prado also caught him in a very deep guillotine on a takedown attempt in R3 before he escaped (Cageside).
how_they_fight.Pace & cardio: Goes the distance well. Of his 12 wins, four are decisions; his eight finishes came in R1 (three KO/TKOs, two submissions), R2 (two KO/TKOs) and R3 (one submission, Frunza). Losses: two decisions and KO/TKOs in R1 (one) and R2 (two). He kept wrestling through R3 against Prado after an eye poke that drew a point deduction; the cards read 30-26 x3 (Cageside).
how_they_fight.Fight IQ: Has shifted toward a wrestling-first plan. Tough: 'I can actually say I'm about that life,' he said after Prado (Cageside).

patterns: Takedowns, long top control and back takes in his last two fights
Real power in the hands when he stands
Knocked out by both strikers who beat him in the UFC
concerns: A rangy striker who keeps him at distance
Gets hit when he stands and trades
Being caught on his shots (deep Prado guillotine)
keys_to_beat: Stay at range and strike; don't get pinned on the fence
Punish his level changes with knees or front headlocks

news.text: Chosen by Stephen Thompson for his retirement fight; Thompson said Radtke has 'tremendous potential'.
Beat Francisco Prado by unanimous decision (30-26 x3) after surviving an eye poke and a deep guillotine.
